column1: for Plantation Region Act, No. 32 of 2018

New Villages Development Authority: facilitate  the  issuance  of  title  deeds  for  the
legal occupants of the houses in the Estates
within  the  designated  areas  to  grant    them
ownership  of  such  houses;
provide assistance to the youth in the estate
sector in the designated areas to  enter  the
tertiary and higher educational institutions for
their educational development;
work with Provincial Council Ministries and
other regional level offices of the Government
Ministries  to  facilitate  the  provision  of
essential services to the communities in the
designated  areas;
promote alternative livelihood opportunities
and  provide  necessary  guidance  and  inputs
in respect thereof to the Estate communities
in the designated areas;
empower the different  community groups in
the estate sector including  women, children,
elders and  differently abled people to uplift
their livelihood;
ensure that descendants of  legal occupants
of the houses in Estates are  provided with all
facilities  that  are  enjoyed    by    such      legal
occupants in Estates in the designated areas;
strengthen conservation measures at all levels,
both  preventive  and  remedial,  aimed  at
minimizing physical degradation of land and
water resources and eliminating environmental
pollution in the designated areas;
identify hazardous sites, in consultation with
the National Building Research Organization
